fixed.summary: A halo a document drawn over the scene sets on its root (`text-shadow: var(--tag-halo)`, inherited) now stops at a surface with a fill of its own: a `<button>`, a `<badge>` and a frame (except a `.bare` one), band, row, cell, badge, well or tab part reset `text-shadow` in the default style, so text on a HUD's panels and buttons is no longer outlined. A rule a document writes for the element still wins.
